definitions.explanation: An active volcano (2,038 m) northwest of Morioka, the highest mountain in Iwate Prefecture; its symmetrical shape earns it the nickname Nanbu Fuji.

examples.japanese: {岩手山|いわてさん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{登|のぼ}った→登る：00660_noboru⟧。
{盛岡|もりおか}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{町|まち}→町：00613_machi⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{岩手山|いわてさん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦よく→よく：00601_yoku⟧⟦{見|み}える→見える：01165_mieru⟧。
examples.english: Mount Iwate can be seen clearly from the city of Morioka.

examples.japanese: ⟦{冬|ふゆ}→冬：00623_fuyu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{岩手山|いわてさん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{雪|ゆき}→雪：00584_yuki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{覆|おお}われ→覆う：02020_oou⟧、{南部富士|なんぶふじ}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{呼|よ}ばれる→呼ぶ：00766_yobu⟧⟦{美|うつく}しい→美しい：01121_utsukushii⟧⟦{姿|すがた}→姿：03363_sugata⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}せる→見せる：01988_miseru⟧。
examples.english: In winter Mount Iwate is covered in snow and shows the beautiful form that earns it the name Nanbu Fuji.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {岩手山|いわてさん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{登|のぼ}る→登る：00660_noboru⟧: to climb Mount Iwate
- {南部富士|なんぶふじ} / {岩手富士|いわてふじ}: nicknames for Mount Iwate

CULTURAL NOTE:
The mountain is a symbol of {盛岡|もりおか}. The poet {石川啄木|いしかわたくぼく}, who grew up nearby, wrote of his home mountain in a famous tanka: ふるさと⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{山|やま}→山：02168_yama⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{向|む}ひて⟦{言|い}ふ→言う：00515_iu⟧ことなし ふるさと⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{山|やま}→山：02168_yama⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧ありがたきかな.
